notes.title: Upcoming updates?!
notes.content:
Hi!

First of all, thank you so much for all the support on Dodgy Deliveries, this week we hit new peak players that we haven't seen in months, so thank you so much!

We have planned 2 FREE major updates that will come in the upcoming months.

First one will be LOTS of improvements and things to do on our current map, translations in Korean, Chinese, Japanese and Russian.

Second one will be a complete new map and a new way to infinitely play Dodgy Deliveries.

Stay tuned, next week we will release a Video talking about what's next in detail.

If you want to play more games made by us, we released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623590/The_5th_Door/]The 5th Door[/url], our second game we made to take a small break of Dodgy Deliveries.


Thank you so much for the support for this little 2 man studio, if you want to help us just leaving a game review or telling your friends about the game is more than enough!

notes.title: Improvements + Studio update
notes.content:
Some tiny fixes and improvements!

-Minor Adjustments on monsters and day cycles
-Skitter will no longer jump to you in the office
-PVP mode removed, since some players first experience was being PVP Mode and it was not very very fun we decided to focus on other things and remove it from the game.

We will be active and fixing + doing some improvements, the simplest the improvements we can do the better (ex: playing around with monsters difficulty / day night cycle and timings, any feedback here would be appreciated)
[b]
STUDIO UPDATE[/b]

Sorry for the lack of updates, we were working on a new title that you can find here if you are interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623590/The_5th_Door/

This game was a way for us to take a creative break from Dodgy Deliveries, and come up with new and fresh ideas.

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Our new game is out!
notes.content:
Our second game as a Studio was released!

In the 5th door you find yourself in a quiet room with four doors. There's always an anomaly. Choose wisely.

It's our creative take on the anomaly genre, super spooky with escape room vibes and short!

Make sure to check it out for 20% off until May 30th or just wishlist it <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623590/The_5th_Door

Thank you so much for the support on Dodgy Deliveries, we will be back working on Dodgy Content very very soon

notes.title: Enter The 5th Door – Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

While working hard on Dodgy Deliveries, we took a short creative break and made something new—The 5th Door. It's a mysterious, atmospheric adventure we’re super proud of. The game is coming in just a few weeks!

We’re still a tiny team of just 2 people, and projects like this help us stay energized and support future content for Dodgy Deliveries. Every wishlist goes a long way to boost visibility and give us the fuel we need to keep going 

If you enjoyed Dodgy, we hope you’ll check out The 5th Door. It’s a different kind of ride, but one that still carries the soul and care you’ve come to expect from us.

🎯Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623590/The_5th_Door/

Thanks for the amazing support—can’t wait to get into new Dodgy content! <3

notes.title: First patch!
notes.content:
Stuff fixed: (Thanks for the feedback we love you so much)

[list]
[*]Now you can move backwards
[*]You no longer see deliverable orders of your teammates (In the past you were able to see where your partners needed to deliver and that led into confusion thinking that you needed to deliver there)
[*]Emotes bugfixes
[*]Now you can move backwards
[*]Softlock when joining game
[*]You now can invite your friends by pressing F in the lobby
[/list]

Stuff pending:
[list]
[*]Sometimes you randomly teleport out of your bike - We still are looking into this
[*]We are working on new monsters! Any suggestion is accepted on the Discord server ( https://discord.gg/HGymKKBPZf ). We love your feedback and we want you to be part of the game
[/list]


On other notes. We achieved 1800 Wishlists for the game and more than 1k people downloaded the game. Thank you so much!

We want to make this game as fun as possible, so please keep playing, recording and sending feedback! We will reward every player that helps us in the current game.


Also. If you are a game publisher, please reach out at info@delivergames.fun !
